verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Every attack on the dispatch list is refuted against live bytes. The harness object is == exact to live parent v4 harnesses[DR-G03], equal under canonical serialisation and identical in key order. The retarget is surgical: diffing parent v3 against parent v4 shows exactly one differing key in the whole G03 entry, artifactPathWhenAuthored, and the G01, G02, G04 and G05 entries are byte-identical, so the measurement content this file carries is the content that was independently ACCEPTed at 0/0. CLAUDE-G03-V1-SF1 is landed by the repair its own text prescribed — a parentReview object with path, digest 3f2146ec measured equal, and the ACCEPT standing — and the subject exceeds that by disclosing that the ACCEPT is of parent-content v3, that Codex did not review, and that the pinned parent v4 is itself awaiting review, each of which I confirmed independently. v1 is unmoved at d2d0727b and not overwritten, path occupancy is self-consistent and corroborated by parent v4, the claim and owner are character-equal to the live DR-G03 row, all three retained-evidence limbs are supplied, no D-006 unit arises because G03's bounds are already in ms, nothing is QUALIFIED or SATISFIED, required-now is unchanged, and the subject did not move. Four further refutations of my own — that the parentReview pin misleads, that the file sits elsewhere than it says, that the carried claim diverges from the register, and that the no-load protocol ptraces the timed child or passes vacuously — all failed. I also applied the test that rejected harness.DR-G04.core-memory.v3 and it does not reach here, because every clause of this subject's authorityClaim is true; the stale occupancy claim in G03 v3 is recorded for the coordinator as that artifact's defect, not this one's.
